┌─ New character ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Make a character: a name and a class.                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Name   Zedd   3 to 16 letters                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Class                                                                                                                                    │
│   1  Warrior  Tank. Holds enemies with Taunt and Bash and heals itself; no mana.                                                         │
│   2  Cleric   Healer. Minor Heal for allies, Smite for enemies; mana.                                                                    │
│   3  Rogue    Melee damage. Backstab from behind, Sneak to hide; no mana.                                                                │
│ > 4  Wizard   Spell damage. Flame Dart and Frost Bolt from range; fragile; mana.                                                         │
│   5  Paladin  Tank and healer. Holy Strike, Challenge and healing hands; mana.                                                           │
│   6  Druid    Healer and nature damage. Thorn Bolt and Mend; mana.                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Type the name. Tab or Down moves to the classes: Up / Down or 1-6 choose.                                                                │
│ Enter makes the character and plays it. Ctrl+C quits.                                                                                    │
